**P2.4 trap, measured.** Feeding applied bundles through activeScopeExplainsFile would credit DurableScope routes and the archive directory prefix: a later edit to a graph document, or a file under archive/C-* that no File or Glob names, would become explained. That is a file nobody approved. Credit must not reuse that function. Matching must be observedWriteScopeContains on the applied plan's ObservedWriteScope only, plus the one alias the archive move requires (below). Every archived Glob in this repository is .ngrace/changes/active/C-ID/run/** (C-ONE-GLOB-LANGUAGE measured; re-measured this session, ten plans). File entries name active/ bundle paths. After archive those bytes live under archive/. Exact OWS match alone cannot credit the moved files, so the post-apply nag of the bundle itself would remain. The alias is that relocation of the same approved suffix, not a new glob.

**F82, measured.** AC-SUITE-AND-LINT in the model plan is Satisfies-linked to the final task; that task ends before apply and archive; its Verification does not include lint; the recorded pass cannot evidence the close-time 0/0 bar. This spec therefore splits: the task-observable half stays an AC the plan Satisfies-links; the post-archive lint half is close-verdict evidence, not an AC-*. This bundle's own plan must use that split.

Goals.Goal: **Applied credit.** collectObservedDrift consults archived bundles whose spec status is applied and whose plan status is applied. A porcelain path matching that plan's ObservedWriteScope via observedWriteScopeContains is explained, not unexplained. The OWS is read by the same extractor active scopes use (extractObservedWriteScope); do not fork a second File/Glob walker. README.md is unchanged. examples/ is unchanged.

**Credit bound.** Rejected, cancelled, and superseded archives grant no credit, even when their OWS would match. Applied credit does not use DurableScope routes and does not use the bundle-directory prefix rule. Do not pass applied scopes through activeScopeExplainsFile. A path no approved or applied OWS covers stays unexplained. Approved globs are not rewritten or narrowed; a wide glob is the approved width.

**Archive alias.** For applied C-ID only, a porcelain path under .ngrace/changes/archive/C-ID/ is also explained when observedWriteScopeContains holds against the same suffix under .ngrace/changes/active/C-ID/. POSIX slashes at the helper. No other rewrite.

**Honest nextAction.** Unexplained drift still uses the existing refresh sentence and never recommends committing. approved-contract-drift stays the hard stop. When credit empties unexplainedFiles, unexplained-observed-drift leaves and nextAction leaves that sentence by the existing ladder. Do not add ratify. Do not add a commit recommendation.

**Decided here — credit predicate.** A porcelain path is explained when either (1) an active approved scope explains it exactly as today (activeScopeExplainsFile unchanged), or (2) an archived bundle with spec status applied and plan status applied has an ObservedWriteScope for which observedWriteScopeContains is true on that path, or (3) that same applied bundle satisfies the archive alias in the Goals. The applied reader lives in scope.ts beside collectActiveChangeScopes, reuses extractObservedWriteScope, and does not return DurableScope for credit. collectActiveChangeScopes stays active-only. Git unavailable still yields available false and empty lists.

**Decided here — what stops over-credit.** Statuses rejected, cancelled, and superseded never enter the applied reader. Applied credit does not call activeScopeExplainsFile. The alias rewrites only archive/C-ID/ to active/C-ID/ for that same C-ID before the same matcher; it does not invent a glob and does not credit a suffix the OWS does not cover. A human-approved wide Glob is not narrowed. No WriteEvidence intersection. No apply-Decision requirement. No time window beyond porcelain (committed paths are not in the set).

**Decided here — what existing reports do.** Intentional: paths that match applied credit leave unexplainedFiles and enter explainedFiles; unexplained-observed-drift leaves when that list is empty; nextAction then leaves the refresh sentence via the existing ladder; the Observed Drift text line uses the new sentence even when only active credit ran, so the line does not lie. Not changed: active explanation (OWS, bundle prefix, durable routes); approved-contract-drift and its hard stop; tracked spec.xml / plan.xml of an active approved bundle still unexplained for that state; review scope audit; execute skill folklore; module-health nextAction; schemaVersion 1.0.0; no new derived-state token; no per-file explained-by field.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CREDIT-BOUND: A porcelain path matching only a rejected, cancelled, or superseded archive's OWS stays unexplained. A porcelain path that no active approved OWS and no applied OWS covers stays unexplained, including a graph or verification file an applied DurableScope would have routed and a file under archive/C-ID/ that the alias plus OWS do not cover. **HEAD today:** already true: there is no applied reader, so nothing is over-credited (F45; regression once the reader exists). **Failure conditions:** rejected credit; durable-route credit for applied; prefix credit of an undeclared archive file.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-ALIAS: Given applied C-ID whose OWS names .ngrace/changes/active/C-ID/rest (File or a Glob that matches that active path), a porcelain .ngrace/changes/archive/C-ID/rest is explained. A different suffix under that archive directory is not explained by the alias alone. **HEAD today:** no alias. **Failure conditions:** inventing a directory-prefix credit; rewriting a path that is not this C-ID; using path.sep at the test instead of normalizing at the helper.
